description: Pendle Parking Information is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Pendle Borough Council. This dataset details information about parking spaces and our parking account. The parking account includes all income from off street parking and enforcement activities. Expenditure includes costs for the provision and maintenance of designated parking spaces by the local authority and enforcement activities. Parking in all of Pendle Council's car parks is free. Coverage: Pendle Borough Council. The portal files it under the publisher Pendle Borough Council. The portal shows 2018-10-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
